NO caption and NO first comment on any feed post (test setup). Posting date Mon Nov 9 (next unused folder after Nov 8; posts publish a day or two later). Characters: Homebody 1 (#2), Hot Mess 2 (#4, #10), Settled One 1 (#6), Bold One 1 (#8); no Glamorous One. Stories: Hot Mess 2, Homebody 1, Settled One 1.
